content.rendered:
Hello incoming kindergarten families. We are so excited for you to join Middleton and be apart of our school this fall. We will be hosting two playdates on our school playground for all incoming kinders. This is a great time to meet the teachers, principal and your future classmates. Join us for a craft, have a snack and enjoy playing together on the school playground. No rsvp is necessary, you can come to one or both of the play dates.

July 29th and August 17th – 6:30-7:30

Please contact Alyssa Thompson for more information: athompson@sherwood.k12.or.us or call her 503-825-5087
